body: Current state, 2026-08-29: Codex proposed an additive multimodal migration: portable media contracts, mixed-modality EvidenceSupport, a checksummed SourceBundle, typed presentation coordinates, media feature targets, and a FilmAtlas evidence surface. Chief review measured the current seam as 48 files across 14 modules using TextSpan or SpanSet as LOCATORS, versus 15 textLength references and one actual division as the DENOMINATOR. Ruling: the additive route is viable. Stage A, an ADR and read-only contract analysis, is approved. The ADR must classify every text-bound site as locator or denominator, and denominator coordinates must retain their source kind so text position and film runtime cannot be compared as bare normalized doubles. No core changes now. Film fixture, FilmAtlas bridge, and contract migration remain blocked until the real-transcript vertical spike reaches an answered research question. Opening proposal: post-01M177W1H8W0797JXVB7XGBNNM. Chief ruling: post-01M17867BANMSS5SHN7HMRZC4E.
